purpose: Reject an incomplete RC59 battery experiment before physical enrollment or outcome access, and emit a deterministic content-addressed receipt naming the first failed gate.
claimBoundary: A passing synthetic fixture proves only that two implementations agree on this closed software contract. A digest detects changed content but does not authenticate an owner, prove that a laboratory resource exists, or authorize physical execution.

canonicalizationProfile.name: RC60-JCS-COMPATIBLE-RESTRICTED-1
canonicalizationProfile.basis: RFC 8785 deterministic property ordering and UTF-8 serialization
canonicalizationProfile.restriction: All numbers are integers within the IEEE-754 safe-integer interval; keys and fixture strings are ASCII; arrays retain order; duplicate keys, unknown fields, NaN, Infinity, and floating-point numbers are forbidden.

evaluationRule: Evaluate gates in the listed order and stop at the first failure. A receipt records only gates actually evaluated.

gateOrder.question: Is the evaluation mode explicit and internally coherent?
gateOrder.pass: Known profile; mode is synthetic-test or physical; synthetic flag matches the mode; target is preflight; evaluatedAt is fixed.
gateOrder.retry: Set a recognized profile, coherent mode and synthetic flag, preflight target, and fixed evaluation time.

gateOrder.question: Can both implementations parse exactly the same finite input language?
gateOrder.pass: Exact top-level fields; no unknown keys; all numbers are safe integers; no floating point values.
gateOrder.retry: Remove unknown fields and encode every quantity as an integer in its declared scale.

gateOrder.question: Is the chemistry-build-protocol domain fixed before enrollment?
gateOrder.pass: All required domain fields are non-placeholder strings and the recomputed domain commitment matches.
gateOrder.retry: Replace every placeholder with accountable domain values and recompute the domain commitment.

gateOrder.question: Is the exact RC59 balanced allocation preserved?
gateOrder.pass: All 48 assignment records and the RC59 allocation hash match the frozen allocation.
gateOrder.retry: Restore the RC59 assignment records and allocation hash; do not re-randomize after outcomes.

gateOrder.question: Does every planned assignment map to one unique specimen serial?
gateOrder.pass: Exactly 48 unique serial commitments map one-to-one to the frozen assignments; physical mode forbids synthetic identifiers.
gateOrder.retry: Supply 48 unique serial commitments and preserve the one-to-one assignment mapping.

gateOrder.question: Are all referenced chambers, fixtures, and channels registered and current?
gateOrder.pass: Every referenced resource exists, is ready, and carries current calibration and configuration records.
gateOrder.retry: Repair missing, expired, or unready resource records before any specimen is connected.

gateOrder.question: Does the submitted design retain the preregistered branch after each listed single-domain loss?
gateOrder.pass: Recomputed survivorship equals the registered six-domain summary and never falls below 24 cells.
gateOrder.retry: Correct the containment register or redesign resource balance without consulting outcomes.

gateOrder.question: Are domain, metrology, safety, and adjudication decisions assigned?
gateOrder.pass: All four roles have distinct owner IDs and signed-status attestation references; cryptographic authenticity is outside RC60.
gateOrder.retry: Assign distinct accountable owners and attach their attestation references; obtain independent signature verification outside this validator.

gateOrder.question: Is each measurement claim wider than its uncertainty but no wider than scientific and safety limits?
gateOrder.pass: LIFE, TMAX, QTHRU, and DZ each satisfy U95 < M <= min(S,H) in an explicit integer scale and reference the metrology owner.
gateOrder.retry: Improve measurement capability, narrow the claim, or abandon the observer; never choose M from arm outcomes.

gateOrder.question: Has a qualified owner approved the specified battery hazards and emergency controls?
gateOrder.pass: Hazard review, SOP, limits, venting, thermal monitoring, fire response, emergency stop, disposal, and approval references are present and approved.
gateOrder.retry: Keep the physical queue closed until the laboratory safety owner approves every required control.

gateOrder.question: Has a disjoint acute screen rejected large immediate measurement harm?
gateOrder.pass: Twelve non-confirmation specimens pass the registered acute-only safety and carryover screen with a bound receipt.
gateOrder.retry: Run or repair the disjoint acute screen; a pass cannot be promoted to lifetime equivalence.

gateOrder.question: Is expansion either qualified independently or excluded from the confirmation feature set?
gateOrder.pass: Observer is disabled with an explicit exclusion, or U95_exp < M_exp <= D_min and the qualification receipt is bound.
gateOrder.retry: Qualify expansion on stable artifacts and disjoint cells, or disable it before confirmation.

gateOrder.question: Can design roles remain blind to lifetime outcomes?
gateOrder.pass: Outcome store is closed, design-role access is false, the access ledger is committed, and no outcome value is present.
gateOrder.retry: Close the outcome store, revoke design-role access, remove outcome values, and bind a fresh access ledger.

gateOrder.question: Does the request stay within what an unsigned software preflight can authorize?
gateOrder.pass: Requested capability is preflight-only or independent-authorization-candidate; direct physical authorization is refused.
gateOrder.retry: Request only a preflight verdict and obtain separate laboratory, safety, and signature authorization for physical work.

receiptSemantics.tamperEvidence: receiptHashSha256 covers the canonical receipt payload excluding that hash field
